'''Eradicator E8U''' was an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] owned by [[Vanel (Human)|Vanel]]. It was a [[Color/Legends|brassy]], angular droid, standing 1.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and armed with [[armsaw blade]]s and [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]].
